title: Famous Volcanoes
intro: Ten questions on well-known volcanoes: when they last erupted significantly, where they are and what they look like. Every answer shows its source.

questions.prompt: Which volcano's most recent significant eruption in the NOAA database was in 1707?
questions.explain: Fujisan (Mount Fuji) has one significant eruption in the NOAA database, in 1707; Vesuvius last erupted in 1944.

questions.prompt: Which of these volcanoes had its single significant eruption in 1815?
questions.explain: Tambora in Indonesia erupted in 1815, the only significant eruption NOAA records for it.

questions.prompt: Which of these Mediterranean volcanoes had its most recent significant eruption in 1944?
questions.explain: NOAA lists 1944 as the latest significant eruption of Vesuvius; Etna's latest listed is 2018 and Stromboli's 2024.

questions.prompt: Which of these volcanoes had its most recent significant eruption in 1980?
questions.explain: NOAA lists 1980 as the most recent significant eruption of St. Helens in the United States; Kilauea's is 2018.

questions.prompt: Which of these volcanoes has the highest summit?
questions.explain: Cotopaxi in Ecuador is 5,911 m; Popocatepetl is 5,393 m, Galeras 4,276 m and Mauna Loa 4,170 m.

questions.prompt: In which country is Mayon, famous for its near-perfect cone?
questions.explain: Mayon is a stratovolcano in the Philippines; NOAA records 18 significant eruptions for it.

questions.prompt: Which of these volcanoes does NOAA classify as a shield volcano?
questions.explain: NOAA classes Kilauea as a shield volcano; Fujisan, Pinatubo and Popocatepetl are stratovolcanoes.

questions.prompt: Which of these is classified by NOAA as a caldera?
questions.explain: NOAA classes Krakatau as a caldera; Etna, Mayon and Fujisan are stratovolcanoes.

questions.prompt: Which of these volcanoes has the most recent significant eruption in the NOAA database?
questions.explain: Nyiragongo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo last had one in 2021; Pinatubo in 1993, Vesuvius in 1944 and Fujisan in 1707.

questions.prompt: Which of these volcanoes has the most significant eruptions recorded by NOAA?
questions.explain: Etna has 25 significant eruptions on record; Popocatepetl has 3 and Tambora and Fujisan one each.
